descriptors.concept_name: Disclosures for joint venture and associate
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose material summarised financial information for each joint venture and associate, including assets, liabilities, revenue, and profit or loss elements. These figures must reconcile to the carrying amount of the investment after factoring in equity method adjustments or permitted alternative bases.
inclusion: Current and non-current assets and liabilities of material joint ventures and associates
Revenue, profit or loss, and comprehensive income components
Dividends received and equity method reconciliation items
exclusion: Subsidiary consolidation disclosures not governed by associate and joint venture rules
Unadjusted investee financial statement figures when equity adjustments are required
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from general subsidiary disclosure requirements by focusing strictly on associates and joint ventures under the equity method or fair value exceptions.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure for subsidiary, associate or joint venture classified as held for sale
descriptors.definition: When an entity's interest in a subsidiary, joint venture, or associate is classified as held for sale under specific standards, standard summarised financial information disclosures are exempted. Separate financial statements require specific declarations regarding exemption usage, listing significant investments, and describing accounting methods.
inclusion: Declarations of separate financial statements and consolidation exemptions
Lists of significant investments detailing principal place of business, ownership proportions, and voting rights
Descriptions of accounting methods applied to subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates
exclusion: Standard summarised financial information disclosures for investees classified as held for sale
Consolidated financial statement disclosures when consolidation is validly omitted
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between active equity-accounted investments requiring full summarised metrics and those classified as held for sale which receive disclosure relief.
